cohort: The study included 350 pregnant women delivering at a tertiary care hospital in North India.
finding: Inadequate gestational weight gain was linked with preterm labour, low birth weight, and anaemia, while excessive gestational weight gain was associated with gestational diabetes mellitus, hypertensive disorders, and an increased LSCS rate.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with an increased LSCS (Lower Segment Caesarean Section) rate.
